records.title: Probing the Efficacy of Hardware-Aware Weight Pruning to Optimize the SpMM Routine on Ampere GPUs
records.reason: ACM full text was not accessible. The paper examines hardware-aware pruning to optimize sparse matrix multiplication on Ampere GPUs; useful to block-pruning/kernel execution lineage, but transformer-specific impact is not confirmed from primary text.

records.title: Self-Distillation Mixup Training for Non-autoregressive Neural Machine Translation
records.reason: Self-distillation mixup is a training method for non-autoregressive translation intended to improve NAR quality. It leaves the inference paradigm unchanged and does not establish a new compute/latency reduction beyond parallel decoding.

records.title: Mask and Predict: Multi-step Reasoning for Scene Graph Generation
records.reason: ACM primary full text was unavailable, so the scene-graph reasoning method cannot be conclusively checked against the linked non-autoregressive sequence-model lineage.

records.title: Representing LLMs in Prompt Semantic Task Space
records.reason: This paper represents LLMs in a semantic task space to characterize model capabilities and task fit. It is a model-selection/analysis representation, not an inference efficiency improvement.

records.title: F-MALLOC: Feed-forward Memory Allocation for Continual Learning in Neural Machine Translation
records.reason: F-MALLOC allocates feed-forward neural memory for continual-learning machine translation to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Its memory refers to task-specific continual-learning allocation, not inference memory/KV cache.
